title: International Foundation Diploma In Health and Social Care (Level 3)
description: Empower your career in compassion and care with the International Foundation Diploma in Health and Social Care (Level 3).
longDescription: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of core principles in health and social care, Responsibilities of a Health and Social Care worker, Personal and Professional Development in Health and Social Care, Health, Safety and Wellbeing in Health and Social Care Settings, and health promotion. Students will develop essential skills in communication, critical thinking, and person-centered care to prepare for diverse challenges in the sector. After the successful completion of the Programme, you will earn a UK 60 credit hours Certification awarded by GSS partners.
courseDetails: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of core principles in health and social care, including the responsibilities of a health and social care worker, personal and professional development, and effective communication and ethical practice. Students will explore health, safety, and wellbeing in care settings, person-centered approaches, and the effective handling of information. Emphasis is placed on developing essential skills in communication, critical thinking, and ethical decision-making to prepare for diverse challenges in the sector.
courseDetailParagraphs: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of core principles in health and social care, including the responsibilities of a health and social care worker, personal and professional development, and effective communication and ethical practice. Students will explore health, safety, and wellbeing in care settings, person-centered approaches, and the effective handling of information. Emphasis is placed on developing essential skills in communication, critical thinking, and ethical decision-making to prepare for diverse challenges in the sector.
entry: For the International Foundation Diploma In Health and Social Care (Level-3), learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: Upon completing the International Foundation Diploma in Health and Social Care (Level 3), students become eligible to pursue advanced studies, including admission into a bachelor’s degree. This qualification opens doors to various programs, allowing students to specialize further in areas such as public health, social work, or healthcare management.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.
certificateDetails: You will receive a degree from GSS Partner Universities.
Complete several modules ranging from Business Leadership and Managing People.
Obtain a degree without necessarily leaving your country.

modules.title: Level 3-Health, Safety And Wellbeing In Health And Social Care Settings
modules.summary: This module focuses on understanding the key principles of health, safety, and wellbeing within health and social care settings. It equips students with the knowledge and practical skills required to ensure the safety and wellbeing of service users, staff, and visitors. The module covers risk assessment, safe practice, and legislation relevant to maintaining health and safety standards in care environments.

Unit 2 Risk Assessment and Management in Health and Social Care
Unit 3 Legislation and Policies for Health and Safety in Care Settings
Unit 4 Promoting Wellbeing and Preventing Harm in Health and Social Care Environments

modules.title: Level 3-Responsibilities Of A Health And Social Care Worker
modules.summary: This module provides an in-depth understanding of the roles and responsibilities of health and social care workers, focusing on ethical practices, safeguarding, effective communication, and maintaining professionalism. Students will explore legal frameworks, duty of care, and strategies for promoting well-being, preparing them to meet the demands of the health and social care sector.
